pages.text: An account's concurrent cloud-station limit scales across 5 tiers by cumulative settled spend (`totalSpent`):$(li)Tier 1 (< 500k): 1 concurrent$(li)Tier 2 (≥ 500k): 2 concurrent$(li)Tier 3 (≥ 2M): 3 concurrent$(li)Tier 4 (≥ 5M): 4 concurrent$(li)Tier 5 (≥ 20M): 5 concurrent$(br)Exceeding the ceiling triggers $(#0E7490)429 rate limiting$(), pausing extra rounds with no charge.
IV passive part mounted on the station's 3×3 frame base (max 1 per station).

pages.title: Model Lifecycle
pages.text: A catalog entry with lifecycle enabled announces $(bold)Leaving Soon$() before its retirement day. A retired entry refuses cloud rounds. Chapter 6 tracks the model families and which features are delivered by each release.

pages.title: Local Fallback Gateway
pages.text: Attach 1× $(item)Local Fallback Gateway$() to the station's 3×3 frame base to keep production moving whenever cloud calls are blocked by $(#0E7490)429 limits$(), $(#0E7490)insufficient Tokens$(), or a $(#0E7490)RETIRED model$():$(li)Runs the task locally at 60 EU/t and $(bold)×4 duration$() (400 ticks base, still scaled by Batch / weather / altitude).$(li)$(bold)Zero Token billing$() and uses no concurrency slot.$(br)Note: a sky-blocked feed horn still blocks both cloud and fallback.
